title: Greptile gives $150,000 in review tokens
summary: Greptile joins as a Distinguished Corporate Patron, giving its pull request review service.

topics.angle: One of four names since October.

claims.text: Across the 60 most recently merged pull requests it reviewed, it flagged 39 problems it rated serious.

to_find: How many of the 39 were confirmed as real
